subject: Literature
title: Paolo Bacigalupi's The Water Knife
description: A short lesson to help you apply Paolo Bacigalupi's The Water Knife.

hook.text: The Water Knife imagines American states going to war with each other over the last drops of drinking water.

buildup.text: In a drought-ravaged Southwest, 'water knives' are corporate enforcers who cut rival states off from water supplies.

discovery.text: Bacigalupi based his fiction on real water rights conflicts already happening in California, Arizona, and Nevada.

twist.text: Climate scientists praised the novel as the most realistic depiction of water scarcity's political consequences.

climax.text: The novel warns that resource scarcity will not bring humanity together but will tear nations apart from within.

punchline.text: The next world war might be fought over a glass of water.

quiz.question: What real-world issue inspired The Water Knife?
options: Rising sea levels threatening coastal cities
Real water rights conflicts in the American Southwest
Pollution of major rivers in developing countries
